rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: a classifier that crashes refuses;
rules.says: If the approved-plan-guard's classifier crashes, the call is refused rather than allowed.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: an unreadable plan file is refused with its reason;
rules.says: A write is refused, with the reason stated, when the plan file cannot be read.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: an edit to the approved plan voids it, and the refusal says so;
rules.says: Editing the approved plan voids its approval, and the refusal that follows says that is why.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: an approval counts only in the session that gave it.
rules.says: A plan approval holds only in the session that gave it and does not carry to another session.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: A refusal now says the action is not a recognised read, and quotes why.
rules.says: When the approved-plan-guard refuses an action it says the action is not a recognised read and quotes the reason.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: **3. plan-guard, talk-first** — BUILT (efb9a93), planted both ways. ExitPlanMode refused unless, since the last rejected ExitPlanMode or the last EnterPlanMode, a turn ended in assistant text and a genuine owner message followed it.
rules.says: ExitPlanMode is refused unless, since the last rejected ExitPlanMode or the last EnterPlanMode, a turn ended in assistant text and a genuine owner message followed it (talk first, then ask for the plan's approval).

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: **Fixed 4ae8731:** a gate's own refusal of ExitPlanMode is recorded with the same denial kind as the owner's rejection
rules.says: A gate's own refusal of ExitPlanMode must not be counted as the owner's answer, so it is told apart from the owner's rejection by its content, so a gate refusal does not cost the owner a message.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: **4. plan-guard, plan-names** — BUILT (efb9a93), planted: an invented name is refused, a real one and a "(new)" one pass.
rules.says: Every code-formatted name in a plan must exist in a session repo, or in a tool result read this session, or be marked "(new)", otherwise the plan is refused.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: It searches code only, since a name the docs merely mention is not one that exists.
rules.says: Plan names are verified against code only; a name that docs merely mention does not count as existing.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: Absolute paths and tokens with spaces are skipped.
rules.says: The plan-names check skips absolute paths and code-formatted tokens that contain spaces.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: **Fixed 4ae8731:** a name written as a call is looked up by its name.
rules.says: A plan name written as a call is looked up by the function's name only.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: reads with a pipe inside their quotes, and `git -C`, pass in plan mode;
rules.says: In plan mode, read commands with a pipe inside their quotes, and `git -C` reads, are allowed.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: every command that can write, in any of its forms, is treated as a write;
rules.says: In plan mode every command that can write, in any form, is treated as a write and refused.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: ExitPlanMode checks the plan the harness passes.
rules.says: ExitPlanMode is checked against the plan text the harness passes with the call.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: **5. drive-guard** — BUILT (d578392), planted 9 of 9, including the owner's own title search passing. Refuses `list_recent_files`, any `fullText` search,
rules.says: Drive access never uses `list_recent_files` or any `fullText` search.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: and any search not scoped by a `parentId` that is in `tools/owner-images.json` or appeared in an earlier tool result, or by an exact `title =` found in the owner's latest message.
rules.says: A Drive search must be scoped by a parentId that is in `tools/owner-images.json` or appeared in an earlier tool result, or by an exact `title =` found in the owner's latest message, otherwise it is refused.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: Refuses Drive writes (create, update, share, trash, copy).
rules.says: Drive writes (create, update, share, trash, copy) are refused.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: Downloads pass only for ids in the index or seen in an earlier tool result.
rules.says: A Drive download is allowed only for a file id that is in the owner-images index or was seen in an earlier tool result.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: **6. stop-guard** — BUILT (d578392, wording ac7c0e2), planted 4 of 4. Adds a third shape: refuses "waiting on you", "waiting for you" and "you owe", declaration or not.
rules.says: A reply must not say "waiting on you", "waiting for you" or "you owe", whether or not it declares a stop.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: Its instructed escape wording changes from "Stopping here, waiting on you for X" to "Stopping here: open for you is X".
rules.says: When stopping on something only the owner can do, the reply uses the wording "Stopping here: open for you is X" and not "Stopping here, waiting on you for X".

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: **Added 0eb20b4:** a reply that asks for a plan's approval in chat is refused, declared stop or not.
rules.says: A reply must not ask for a plan's approval in chat, whether or not it declares a stop.
rules.live_quote: **AND A PLAN-MODE TURN ENDS WITH THE TOOL, NEVER WITH PROSE.** Said twice in
rules.missing: The live page says a plan-mode turn ends with ExitPlanMode and not a prose summary. It does not say that a reply asking for a plan's approval in chat is refused, whether or not it declares a stop.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: **7. compact-brief** — BUILT inside `hook-dispatch.mjs`, planted on this session's transcript. SessionStart with `source: compact` prints every tool name used earlier in the session, with counts,
rules.says: After a compaction, SessionStart prints every tool name used earlier in the session with counts, so a capability (such as the Drive connector's download) cannot drop out of the compaction summary.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: **8. UserPromptSubmit reminder** — BUILT inside `hook-dispatch.mjs`. Injects rules 1, 2 and 4 on each owner message.
rules.says: On each owner message a reminder of rules 1, 2 and 4 is injected into the session.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: **9. Drive fetch methods in `tools/owner-images.mjs`'s header** (JPS) — BUILT on JPS branch `claude/relaxed-bardeen-vlwm3g` (d120f4d). The direct link works only for link-shared folders;
rules.says: To fetch owner images from Drive, the direct link works only for link-shared folders; otherwise use the connector's `download_file_content`, whose oversized result the harness saves to a file, decoded with `jq -r .content FILE | base64 -d > OUT`.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: **Shape:** one reviewer per gate file, ten files across both repos. Then one skeptic per finding, told to refute it by running it.
rules.says: An adversarial review of gates is run as one reviewer per gate file and then one skeptic per finding, told to refute it by running it (the owner's original shape, with one skeptic rather than three because the container allows two workflow agents at a time).

rules.heading: 10. Adversarial review
rules.quote: **Result:** 24 findings. 20 confirmed and fixed in one round, each planted against old and new code
rules.says: Each confirmed gate finding is fixed and checked by planting it against both the old code and the new code.

rules.heading: 10. Adversarial review
rules.quote: an install over an unparsable settings file: the route never arises;
rules.says: Refuted finding: an install over an unparsable settings file is not a route that arises, so it is not a gate defect.

rules.heading: 10. Adversarial review
rules.quote: the report clock's 4 MB tail: unreachable once any status exists;
rules.says: Refuted finding: the report clock's 4 MB tail limit is unreachable once any status exists, so it is not a gate defect.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: plans-directory writes: by design;
rules.says: Writes to the plans directory are allowed by design and are not a gate defect.

rules.heading: 10. Adversarial review
rules.quote: a mid-turn owner message in an attachment shape that never occurs.
rules.says: Refuted finding: a mid-turn owner message in an attachment shape never occurs, so it is not a gate defect.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: **Found and NOT fixed, written as the outcome each gate still owes** (LESSONS §371: gate work is written as outcomes, never as routes past a gate).
rules.says: Gate work is written as the outcome each gate owes, never as a route past a gate.

rules.says: The harness-guard owes: every scratchpad measurement script is checked for its made-to-fail block whenever node runs it, however the command reaches it.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: only a script actually run as a measurement is gated.
rules.says: The harness-guard owes: only a script actually run as a measurement is gated.

rules.quote: plan names are checked against the session's repos wherever the project directory sits;
rules.says: The plan-guard owes: plan names are checked against the session's repos wherever the project directory sits.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: the whole top block of a plan is checked, whatever it contains;
rules.says: The plan-guard owes: the whole top block of a plan is checked, whatever it contains.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: `path:line` spans, and names in superseded plans, pass;
rules.says: The plan-guard owes: `path:line` spans and names in superseded plans pass the names check.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: every read-only command passes in plan mode. Measured refused: `sed -nE`, `git branch --show-current`, `git tag -l` with a pattern,
rules.says: The plan-guard owes: every read-only command passes in plan mode, including `sed -nE`, `git branch --show-current`, `git tag -l` with a pattern, `git remote get-url`, and a read beginning with `cd`, which were measured as wrongly refused.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: Its other side, that every write in plan mode is refused, has NOT been reviewed:

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: a value printed by a command that failed counts as read, so reading it again ends the refusal;
rules.says: The ledger owes: a value printed by a command that failed counts as read, so reading it again ends the refusal.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: trimming never loses an entry appended at the same moment.
rules.says: The ledger owes: trimming never loses an entry appended at the same moment.

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: **drive-guard owes:** a folder listing counts as seen for the whole session, not only while it sits in the transcript's last 8 MB.
rules.says: The drive-guard owes: a folder listing counts as seen for the whole session, not only while it sits in the transcript's last 8 MB, by means of a per-session record (larger than one round).

rules.heading: ## The gates — the approved plan, with build status
rules.quote: **approved-plan-guard owes:** the approval marker changes only when an approval is recorded.
rules.says: The approval marker changes only when an approval is recorded; no string check can promise that alone, so it rests on Doctrine section 0e.

rules.quote: **transcript-tail owes:** an owner message typed mid-turn counts as an owner message.
rules.says: The transcript-tail reader owes: an owner message typed mid-turn counts as a genuine owner message (not yet reviewed).

rules.heading: Found while building, and fixed or recorded
rules.quote: **Both repos' `plan-guard.sh` shims refused every plan-mode call, reads included** — `printf … | exec node` replaces only a pipe's subshell, so the script ran on into its no-gate branch.
rules.says: The plan-guard.sh shim fix (hub efb9a93, JPS work branch d120f4d) is not on JPS main, which still has the old shim that refuses every plan-mode call, reads included, until that branch merges.

rules.heading: ## Found while building, and fixed or recorded
rules.quote: **`wbBias` is real** (`src/main.ts`, a look's white-point gain). The session told the owner it was invented, from a search of five files; rule 13 above.
rules.says: `wbBias` is a real name in `src/main.ts` (a look's white-point gain); a session must not tell the owner a name is invented on the strength of a search of a few files (rule 13).

rules.heading: Found while building, and fixed or recorded
rules.quote: **Two lines of attribution were pushed** before the privacy gate caught them
rules.says: No attribution line may reach a commit; the hub's commit hook now runs `privacy-check.mjs` (`also=privacy-check.mjs`) and a planted attribution is refused at commit.
rules.enforcer: privacy-check.mjs via the hub's commit hook
rules.live_quote: **THE COMMIT MESSAGE IS REFUSED AT THE COMMIT.** ... refuses a message holding a chat link, an attribution trailer or a model's name, from any thread.
rules.missing: The live page puts the refusal in the repository's commit-msg hook from branch-guard.mjs. It does not say the hub's commit hook runs privacy-check.mjs through also=privacy-check.mjs, or that a planted attribution is refused at commit.

rules.heading: Found while building, and fixed or recorded
rules.quote: The tree was fixed in ac7c0e2; those two commits still carry the lines in history.
rules.says: Two commits (HANDOFF.md at 6fbf41c and stop-guard.mjs at d578392) still carry attribution lines in history, though the tree was fixed in ac7c0e2.

rules.heading: ## Found while building, and fixed or recorded
rules.quote: **The ident guard read seven hex letters inside an ordinary word as an identifier** and refused the call.
rules.says: The ident guard counts a hex run as an identifier only as a whole word, while every SHA shape is still caught; the fix is JPS 1f28aa8, on JPS main since 2026-09-29 as PR 178 (11df7b7).

rules.heading: ## Found while building, and fixed or recorded
rules.quote: **Measured: a hook's refusal of a tool is recorded with the same `toolDenialKind` as the owner's own rejection**
rules.says: A hook's refusal of a tool is recorded with the same `toolDenialKind` ("permission-rule") as the owner's rejection, and only the content, opening "PreToolUse:<Tool> hook error: [", tells them apart.

rules.heading: ## Found while building, and fixed or recorded
rules.quote: It pasted a whole plan into chat instead of saying what it was doing (rule 4).
rules.says: A session never pastes a whole plan into chat; it says what it is doing (rule 4, Doctrine §0e).

rules.heading: ## Found while building, and fixed or recorded
rules.quote: Five statuses in a row carried estimated times, forty minutes off the clock (rule 2).
rules.says: A status never carries an estimated time; the time comes from the clock, and `report.mjs` writes the clock's time into every status (b24149e) (rule 2).

rules.heading: ## Found while building, and fixed or recorded
rules.quote: Three statuses carried estimated times, 02:12 to 02:17, while the clock read 02:07 (rule 2). Every time since has been read from the clock.
rules.says: Every time a session states is read from the clock, never estimated.

rules.heading: ## Found while building, and fixed or recorded
rules.quote: Two writes happened in plan mode, both in the scratchpad and outside both repos.
rules.says: No write of any kind, including scratchpad or outside the repos, by a read command or a read-only agent, happens in plan mode; with the gates live such writes are refused.

rules.heading: ## Found while building, and fixed or recorded
rules.quote: **Found and NOT fixed:** LESSONS §369 cites JPS `tools/owner-images.mjs`, which exists only on the unmerged JPS branch
rules.says: LESSONS section 369 cites JPS `tools/owner-images.mjs`, which exists only on the unmerged JPS branch `claude/relaxed-bardeen-vlwm3g`, so `lessons-check.mjs` fails wherever JPS is checked out beside the hub (CI does not see it); merging that branch is the remedy.

rules.heading: ## The setup script — not reachable from the tablet app
rules.quote: Kept for a session that can reach an environment's settings some other way. These lines in the setup script would install the gates in every session.
rules.says: A session that can reach an environment's settings can put the three install lines in the setup script to install the gates in every session; the first new session proves it when its Stop records list more than one hook and a planted Drive search is refused.
rules.missing: The live page has the install lines for an environment's setup script. It does not say how the first new session proves them, by its Stop records listing more than one hook and a planted Drive search being refused.

rules.heading: ## The setup script — not reachable from the tablet app
rules.quote: ## The setup script — not reachable from the tablet app
rules.says: The environment's setup script cannot be reached from the tablet app, so these install lines are for a session that can reach an environment's settings some other way.

rules.heading: ## The setup script — not reachable from the tablet app
rules.quote: mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude"
rules.says: The setup script lines are: make `$HOME/.claude`; pull `$HOME/.claude/hub` with `--ff-only` if it is a clone, else shallow-clone the hub repo there; then run `node $HOME/.claude/hub/hook-dispatch.mjs --install`.
rules.missing: The live script makes the configuration folder, clones the hub if it is absent, and runs hook-dispatch.mjs --install. It does not pull with --ff-only when the hub is already a clone, and its path is /root/.claude rather than $HOME/.claude.

rules.heading: ## What the research workflow measured (for building the gates)
rules.quote: **Genuine owner message**: a `user` entry with no `tool_result` block, not `isMeta`, `origin.kind` "human".
rules.says: A genuine owner message is a `user` transcript entry with no `tool_result` block, not `isMeta`, with `origin.kind` "human"; the 160 "Stop hook feedback" entries are all `isMeta`.

rules.heading: ## What the research workflow measured (for building the gates)
rules.quote: **ExitPlanMode results**: approved content starts "User has approved your plan";
rules.says: ExitPlanMode approval starts "User has approved your plan"; a common rejection is `is_error: true` with `toolDenialKind: "permission-rule"` and the owner's text as content, a rarer one starts "The user doesn't want to proceed with this tool use", `toolDenialKind: "cancelled"` is not a rejection, EnterPlanMode's result starts "Entered plan mode", and plan mode is recorded by `permissionMode` on user entries, not by `type: "mode"` entries.

rules.heading: ## What the research workflow measured (for building the gates)
rules.quote: **Mid-turn text** is recorded for some messages only:
rules.says: A gate cannot rely on reading chat text, because mid-turn text is recorded for only some messages, so report-clock uses its own stamp.

rules.heading: ## What the research workflow measured (for building the gates)
rules.quote: **The transcript is over 512 MB.** Never read it whole; stream or read a tail.
